description: The solution shall act as an integration bus, allowing interoperability between systems, process standardization, and agile incorporation of new functionalities within the English market with NADIN.
The new NiX application shall allow continuing to work with the generation of old documentation while using new technologies.
NiX shall automatically transform old documentation files without users having to make any changes.
The new application shall allow business support users to continue working with familiar systems without directly intervening with new technologies.
The new application shall improve daily process monitoring and problem resolution.
The new application shall reduce the probability of manual errors.
The new application shall unify processes into a single system.
The new application shall facilitate error identification.
The system shall allow users to access the portal by authenticating with personal credentials.
The user is authenticated and can access the portal's functionalities.
The system shall allow users to view the portal applications to which they have access.
The user only sees the applications to which they have access.
The system shall allow users to access the applications to which they have access in the portal.
The user accesses a portal application.
The system shall restrict the viewing and actions (create, modify, and delete) on data according to the roles assigned to the user.
The user can view and perform actions on the data and screens to which they have permission.
The system shall ensure that data from other clients cannot be accessed.
The user can only access the data of the client to which they are associated.
The system shall convert any mention of the old name to the new name.
The user only sees mentions of the new name on both screens and data.
The system shall allow administrators to grant or revoke application access to users.
The list of applications to which the affected user has access will be modified, and the affected user will see the list of applications modified when logging into the portal.
Primary keys must be defined for User, Language, ClusterType, Application, Authority, Role, Brand, and Cluster.
Each language_id in each content table must belong to an existing Language.
Dates must be valid and cannot be later than the present.
For all applicable tables, there cannot be elements of the same type with the same code.
The authorizations and Cluster assigned to a user must be of the same Cluster type as the user.
The authorizations assigned to a user must be from one of the brands that the associated Cluster contains.
The new content must maintain visual consistency with the design of the old version of the application.
The design, colors, typographies, and organization must be consistent with the old version.
The system must be easy to use for any user.
80% of users do not need to ask for third-party help to use the application.
The application must be available in several languages.
Complete and correct translations in both languages.
The user must be able to perform new operations without special training.
The learning time for new functionalities should not exceed 5 minutes.
Query operations must have a loading time of less than 1 second.
Response time should not exceed 1 second for 95% of queries.
The web application must guarantee continuous and stable operation, ensuring its availability at all times.
System availability must be at least 99.9%, even during periods of intensive use.
The web application must support a large number of simultaneous users without degrading its performance.
System availability must be at least 99.9%, even during periods of intensive use.
The system must allow authorized users to create, query, modify, and delete data.
The system must have a secure authentication and permission verification mechanism to ensure that each user can only access the information and functionalities that correspond to them.
The application must manage a strict separation of data for each client.
No user can access data from other clients.
The application must use a microservices-based architecture.
The project team is not responsible for the development or maintenance of the Ordering and GSB microservices.
The application must use a cloud architecture.
The cloud provider for this project must be Amazon Web Services.
Users must access the application from web browsers.
Microservices must be connected to a shared database decoupled by microservice and client, with a schema for each microservice and each client having its group of schemas per microservice.
Each microservice will be deployed in a pod.
Each client will have a specific namespace that groups the application's microservices, meaning microservices will be duplicated for each namespace.
There will be a common namespace for the Leader microservice, which will not be duplicated.
For each development environment (DEV, QA, and PROD), a different cluster will be used.
Repository management must be done using Gitflow.
